confirm.uninstallMessage: Uninstall this app? Provisioned records and fields are retained. Code and execution evidence are archived in the audit trail; packages with platform contribution history are disabled so their references remain intact.

drawer.capabilitiesHelp: Everything else is denied by default; the app's backend and bridge calls are checked against these grants (always intersected with the calling user's own permissions).
drawer.navigationHelp: This app remains installed independently of its menu shortcuts. Add, remove, rename, or move a shortcut in Navigation settings.
drawer.endpointsHelp: The frontend calls these with <call>openbooks.callBackend(name, payload)</call>; each runs its file's <handler>handler(request)</handler> in the sandbox.
drawer.noEndpoints: No endpoints — this app is frontend-only.

editor.draftHelp: Edit an unpublished package. Saving prepares a draft for validation, preview, and activation; it does not change the running app.
editor.name: App name
editor.endpointsHelp: Each action runs its JavaScript handler through the governed app runtime. Edit its implementation in Files.
editor.permissionsHelp: Declare the capabilities this package requires. Calls also remain limited by the current user’s permissions.
editor.grantsHelp: Choose which requested capabilities this version may actually use. New grants are checked against your authority during activation.
editor.definitionsHelp: Edit native screen definitions and all package source in Files. Custom records and fields are provisioned through OpenBooks’ existing object system when the reviewed version is activated.
editor.deleteConfirm: Remove {path} from this draft? Active versions are unchanged.
editor.invalidPath: Use a unique relative path, including a filename, without traversal.
editor.fileTooLarge: Each file must be smaller than 2 MB.
editor.binaryHelp: Binary asset. Download this file to inspect it, or upload a replacement into its folder.
editor.invalidManifest: The manifest is invalid. Open Files to correct it.
editor.notLive: Changes take effect only after activation.
editor.failed: The package could not be saved.
editor.pendingDefinition: Apply or cancel the open definition editor before switching tabs or saving the package.

create.title: New app
create.help: Build native screens or work directly with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other assets. You can also import an existing package and edit it before activation.
create.tooLarge: Choose a ZIP or JSON package smaller than 10 MB.
create.failed: The package could not be imported.

definitions.title: Records, fields, and platform contributions
definitions.help: Manage the definitions shipped by this app. Each definition uses the existing platform services and is validated with the package before activation. Removing a definition does not delete historical records.
definitions.removeConfirm: Remove this contribution from the draft? Review will show the change before activation.
definitions.invalidKey: Use a lowercase key beginning with a letter, with letters, numbers, and hyphens.
definitions.pageHelp: Page contributions customize existing registered pages. Add standalone app screens in the native interface file.

management.permissionsHelp: These grants apply to the running version. Edit the package to prepare a reviewed permission change.
management.lifecycleHelp: Enable or disable this app for your organization. Publishing shares a copy of its active package through the App Library.
management.publishConfirm: Publish the active package, including its source files, to the App Library for other organizations? Review files for private information before sharing.
management.unpublishConfirm: Remove this listing from the App Library? Existing installations keep their copies.
management.disableConfirm: Disable this app and its contributed pages and navigation? Existing records and audit history are retained.
management.enableConfirm: Enable this app and its approved contributions for your organization?
management.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall this app? Provisioned records and fields are retained. Code and execution evidence are archived in the audit trail; packages with platform contribution history are disabled so their references remain intact.
management.failed: The operation could not be completed.
management.versionsHelp: Inspect and export any installed version. Revising a previous version creates a new draft against the current active version.
management.runsHelp: Backend execution history, including errors, logs, resource usage, duration, and actor.
management.auditHelp: Recorded configuration and lifecycle changes with actor and before/after evidence.
management.storageHelp: Inspect app-owned state. Change business data through the app’s governed actions, which preserve its validation and audit rules.

screens.title: Native app screens
screens.help: Manage pages, record workspaces, and action forms. Screen definitions use the native ViewSpec and form schemas; record and action screens connect to governed record types and backend actions.
screens.removeConfirm: Remove this screen from the draft?
screens.invalid: The native screen definition needs correction.
screens.invalidKey: Use a lowercase key beginning with a letter, with letters, numbers, and hyphens.
